coordinate_basis: Actual1280x720 original source pixels, not1080p constants. Main board left65/top613/bottom686; first-set right270; active second-set right301 plus existing2px anti-alias pad gives max303.

bounded_native_probe.claim_limit: Calibration only; no claim of source-wide or final-video scoreboard correctness.

visual_limits: Fixed3:4 center crop loses horizontal outer court and occasional players running wide; do not claim the full width of every rally remains visible. Preserve user-selected fixed-center/full-canvas treatment.
Only native scoreboard is copied back at its established x0/y1227. No invented redraw, displaced position, static full-width rectangle, or copy of absent board during handshake.
Native render still must scan each selected source segment and inspect actual final scoreboard alpha/presence/width.

native_observation.basis: Root reports actual completed native pre-encode log; this annotation does not claim a new independent frame inspection.
native_observation.explanation: 沿用原生左下底部锚点 y1372 和 x0。当前720源比分板73像素高，按原生2倍缩放为146，故顶部1372−146=1226。此前1080源109像素板原生取整为145高，顶部为1227。1像素差异来自缩放后的高度取整，不是手动移动比分板；前期y1227只是沿用旧板高的预估。
